head_commit.message:
fix(core): complete The Ring legend rule and correct its claims

The first Ring implementation grouped a whole same-name creature group as
legendary when only the Ring-bearer was legendary, which would have sacrificed
an ordinary second Grizzly Bears. CR 704.5j counts legendary permanents only;
the SBA and the loader/direct-answer validator now share one predicate, require
the complete same-name legendary group, and refuse a truncated/forged choice.

Also reruns the final four-seat journey after that correction and records the
real digests, the retained native REDs, and the corrected commander-only refusal
reason (the legend rule is implemented; the named command-zone profile owns
those cards).
